content:
YouTube is aware of an issue on Android and iPhone where Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode fails to activate when users close the app.

Some users have experienced problems with the Picture-in-Picture (PiP) feature not triggering while using the YouTube app. A floating player that should pop up in the corner of the screen to let users continue watching fails to appear, with YouTube instead only continuing to play audio in the background.

Google says the "vast majority of related reports come from iOS users," but there are also some cases on Android devices. We were able to reproduce the issue on an iPhone running YouTube app version 21.28, but were unable to reproduce it on a Pixel.

YouTube first identified the issue on Friday morning (Pacific Time) and stated that "the team is actively investigating." However, as of Saturday afternoon, there was still no progress. You can follow YouTube's Help Community thread for the latest updates.

Earlier this year, YouTube began rolling out the Picture-in-Picture feature to free users worldwide.
